gui.better_witch_huts.errand_hint: One errand at a time. Hand it in at any resident; a new one is offered each day.
gui.better_witch_huts.errand_return: Bring it to any resident witch.
gui.better_witch_huts.hex_cures: Hexes stay through death and milk. Do the task, smash a Witch Bottle, or pay a resident.

gui.better_witch_huts.tier_desc.known: The Coven knows your face. Residents sell Poppets, and remedies are cheaper.
gui.better_witch_huts.tier_desc.stranger: The Coven does not know you yet. You may hold one pact.
gui.better_witch_huts.tier_desc.trusted: A friend of the Coven: two pacts, and remedies at a fair price.
